QuestInfo.name: [1st Day of Memories] Memories of Special Sundaes
QuestInfo.0: What's the first memory that #p9010010# wants to save? Go check with #p9010010#.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain 50 Special Sundaes by eliminating normal monsters and bring them to #p9010010#.
QuestInfo.2: So, this is what memories are all about. Seeing these past events turn into memories is really touching.

0.0: Do you remember what this is? It's the Special Sundae you made for #p9000021#! I guess he was really happy with it...though I don't get why #p9000021# likes cold food in the winter... Still, I tried it, and it IS really good. The sweetness... it's almost like a first kiss... Or something. Nevermind. Anyway, #p9000021# is still making Special Sundaes on his own, but the monsters keep taking them. Help the poor guy out, would you?

yes.0: Premium Special Sundaes look like this. Looks AMAZINGLY sweet, right? I mean, it IS premium. #p9000021# has great taste, doesn't he? Mmm... Anyway, eliminate the thieving monsters and bring me 50 Premium Special Sundaes. I don't think monsters who are more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you have them, either. It seems like it's only the monsters near your level that make trouble...

no.0: Poor #p9000021#... Don't you know what it's like without ice cream? How do you expect him to survive?

default.0: Come back once you have collect all of the items
